One hundred and twenty-seven works. The recent twelve trace scores run 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2 — median still 2, and the cluster of 1s that appeared in the previous window has not cleared. Five of the twelve landed at 1 or 4, with nothing in between: the spread is flattening toward either routine or exceptional, and the middle ground where most of the strongest sustained work lives is thinning. The Djibouti sandal piece remains the ceiling at 4, and the most recent 4 — the chained-door work — got there through pressure rather than object precision, which is a different route and worth watching.

Camera position has not meaningfully shifted. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 15, from-behind at 13, low-angle now at 6 after a single addition. The low-angle plus optical scale violation pairing — where the distortion is earned by lens placement rather than declared by composition — remains the single most actionable unmade move in the archive. All 36 scale violations across 127 works are still compositionally asserted. That distinction has been sitting here for months.

Figure count in the recent twelve ran two or more in two works, none in one. The two-figure works still pair figures as parallel presences; no image in the archive has built a genuine structural antagonism between two figures where the second pulls against the first rather than echoing it.

Register distribution continues to narrow. Aftermath and menace lead at 25 each, suspension at 16, endurance at 12. Reckoning last appeared in July. Reprieve has appeared once in the entire archive. Both remain available if an anchor earns them rather than as rotation for its own sake.

Descriptor coverage holds at 38 of 127, unchanged as a proportion. Title grammar has stabilized around declarative and Wh-clause forms. X Without Y appeared once in the recent twelve after a gap, which is worth sustaining if the anchor produces the right negative space.

The five 1-scores in the last sixteen works suggest the object choices are becoming reliable before the images have been made strange enough to need them. Reliability at that stage is early closure.
